findings.title: Critical: tar <=7.5.18 has multiple CVEs (installed 7.5.16)
findings.detail: tar 7.5.16 is installed as a transitive devDependency via @grafana/faro-bundlers-shared. It is affected by: GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw (critical, CVSS 7.5 - Decompression/parse DoS via unlimited input), GHSA-8x88-c5mf-7j5w (high, CVSS 7.5 - infinite loop via negative entry size), GHSA-w8wr-v893-vjvp (moderate - PAX numeric path type confusion), GHSA-gvwx-54wh-qm9j (moderate - uncaught exception via NUL byte). Risk is limited to build time (devDep only); the Chrome extension bundle is not affected at runtime.
findings.suggested_fix: npm audit fix to update tar to a patched version (>=7.5.19)

findings.title: Moderate: @opentelemetry/core <2.8.0 unbounded memory allocation (GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf)
findings.detail: GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf (CVSS 5.3) - unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation. Affects production dependencies @grafana/faro-web-sdk and @grafana/faro-web-tracing (installed 2.7.1, latest 2.8.2 which pulls in patched @opentelemetry/core >=2.8.0). These packages are bundled into the Chrome extension and run in user browsers. Fix is within the existing ^2.4.0 semver range.

findings.title: Major: react and react-dom at v18.3.1, latest v19.2.7
findings.detail: react and react-dom are pinned at ^18.3.1 (installed 18.3.1). React 19 is a major version with breaking changes in the rendering model, hooks, and ref handling. Upgrading requires testing the popup UI (Popup.tsx) carefully.
findings.suggested_fix: Upgrade react and react-dom to ^19.0.0 alongside @types/react and @types/react-dom after validating Popup.tsx compatibility

findings.title: All recent CI runs on main show 'skipped' conclusion
findings.detail: The last 5 GitHub Actions runs on the main branch (2026-06-19 through 2026-06-26) all have conclusion 'skipped'. This may be by design (e.g. path filters with no matching file changes), but no successful run is visible in the recent history.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the workflow trigger conditions and confirm a run completes successfully after the next code push

findings.title: Fix branch pushed but PR creation blocked — GH_TOKEN lacks pull_requests:write
findings.detail: npm audit fix resolved all 14 vulnerabilities (1 critical, 13 moderate). Build and all 351 tests passed. Branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-21-sec-npm-audit-fix was pushed to origin. However, gh pr create failed with 'Resource not accessible by personal access token (createPullRequest)' — the GH_TOKEN fine-grained PAT does not have pull_requests:write permission. A human must open the PR manually from the pushed branch.
findings.suggested_fix: Grant pull_requests:write to the maintenance bot PAT, or open the PR manually from branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-21-sec-npm-audit-fix
